stage: fixed-factor projection dataflow; no endpoint or promotion claim
representation: FP64 lower AO triangle, pair=mu*(mu+1)/2+nu for nu<=mu; Q contiguous; unit value weight
control: full resident B, existing strided-batched cuBLAS occupied projection, existing single SYRK
candidate_boundary: K projection only; all retain U[mu,i,Q] with full leading dimension Naux; no split Gram
order: rotate all six candidates by repeat index; one untimed complete projection before each timed sample
inputs: four eager molecular occupied builds at 384/768 plus 192 prefix, odd unequal 97/193/rank37, independent 13/7/rank9 and zero rank; prefixes are synthetic diagnostic subproblems, not molecular endpoints
comparison: Report all candidates, component and total timings, projection work, logical element loads, expanded writes/reads, U bytes, peak charged common arena and standalone candidate storage. Logical traffic is not a hardware DRAM counter.
selection: Choose the fastest numerically valid bounded projection at 768 for integration; report all smaller/tail regressions. A fixed-input loss cannot alone reject a capacity experiment. No automatic production selection follows this stage.
cutensor_assessment: An exact triangular AO map is nonlinear in (mu,nu), so constant-stride tensor descriptors cannot represent it as one dense contraction. Test a shared-memory tiled FP64 contraction with a logical pair iterator; do not claim a cuTENSOR benchmark.
timing_boundary: Exclude capture, one-time diagnostic packing, uploads, allocation, validation and file IO. Projection timing includes every required unpack. Report Gram separately and the complete projection+Gram+mirror call independently.
required_next_stage: Direct packed generation/whitening, packed J, bounded raw response, owner identity and #203 accounting must precede complete cold/changed/warm and constrained/larger-capacity qualification. Diagnostic full-then-pack is never a promoted producer.

endpoint_gates_to_freeze_before_measurem.work: identical frozen density and normal convergence; changed SCF work retained separately and never pooled with matched-work samples
endpoint_gates_to_freeze_before_measurem.domain: 96/192 regression, 384/768 energy and complete force, cold and changed geometry, unequal auxiliary dimension, constrained and supported larger case

coefficient_layout: column-major (nbf,rank), matching SCF seed/canonical/final calls; row-major capture files are transposed once outside timing
previous_diagnostic: trials-v1 retained row-major C and OP_T BLAS; useful compatibility/numerical evidence only, not the production layout selection
